Manual spawning and sandbox settings. Click a house to recruit a soldier. If the train is full, a new carriage joins the next recruit (maximum 16).

These values apply to manual monster spawns. Edit wave groups in Waves to change scheduled enemies.

Locomotive and carriages

Passengers disembark when a carriage is removed or destroyed. When the train is full, soldiers travel on foot. Carriages protect their passengers.

World

Configure houses, regeneration and production in Gameplay. Configure growth and radius triggers in Waves. The run ends when the vortex reaches its maximum radius.
